name: goddess of sovereignty

attributes.attribute: confirms or withholds a king's rule
works through the sacred marriage rite
depends on her approval to keep the kingship

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The sovereignty goddess confirms or withholds a Celtic king's right to rule. Her favor, granted through the sacred marriage rite called the banais righe, legitimates the monarch. A ruler who lacks this approval risks losing the kingship.

okr.objective: Present the sovereignty goddess as the source of legitimate Celtic kingship.
key_results: The sovereignty goddess sanctions the king's right to rule.
She operates through the sacred marriage rite.
Without her favor a ruler can lose the kingship.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore, 2003
